entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Just connect me to a person already!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, you can help me by taking back this useless piece of garbage you sent me. I want my money back, now!
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To get started, could I get your order number?
It's VF88602. And don't give me the runaround. This ProFit jersey is a complete joke.
Okay, I'm pulling up order VF88602. I see you received the jersey about four days ago. Can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the wrong size! I ordered a Large, which I always wear, and this thing is so ridiculously tight I can barely zip it up. It's defective! Get me your manager, I'm not dealing with this.

I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. I can absolutely handle this for you. It sounds like a sizing issue, and I want to get this sorted out right away. Since it's a jersey, you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy.
Don't just say you'll handle it, DO IT. So what happens now? Are you going to send me a new one or not? I swear if I have to pay for shipping, I'm going to blast VeloFit all over every review site.
No, of course not. We can process an exchange for a different size at no cost to you. I can get that started immediately. Would you like me to set up an exchange for an Extra-Large?
Fine. An Extra-Large. But how do I send back this one that's too tight?

It's a simple process. I'm generating a pre-paid return label for you, which I'll email over as soon as we're done here. You just need to print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once the tracking shows it's on its way back, we'll ship out your new jersey.
Alright. So I get the label, send the wrong size back, and you send the new one. That's it?

That's it exactly. I've just processed the exchange on my end. You should see that confirmation email along with the return label within the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No. Just make sure it actually happens.
It will. Thank you for your call today, and we appreciate your business at VeloFit.
